end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as 1 ten and extra ones.
Discussed examples including 14 and 16.
Saanvi mixed up the meaning of “extra ones” and needed prompting.
They later stated that 16 has 1 ten and 6 ones, but teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended after a short break because Saanvi was tired and dinner time began.
end.parentNote: Asha practised breaking numbers into one ten and some ones, using 14 and 16 as examples. Saanvi later said that 16 is 1 ten and 6 ones, though the idea was not yet consistent in the teach-back. At home, build numbers 11–20 with small objects and ask, “How many tens and how many ones?”
